import sys, json
doc = json.load(sys.stdin)
d = doc["body"]
calls = [m for m in d.get("messages", []) if m.get("type") == "tool_call"]
if not calls:
    sys.stdout.write("[]"); sys.exit(0)
c = calls[0]
name = json.loads(c.get("text", "{}")).get("name", "unknown")
header = {"tool_name": name}
# GH #1085 (R-IG-1): the llm's window (`input_soft`, its catalogue row) rides on
# with the call -- a hop lives for one emission, and a tool cuts its result to
# a share of the window of the model that reads it.
soft = (((doc.get("envelope") or {}).get("header") or {}).get("hop") or {}).get("input_soft")
if isinstance(soft, (int, float)) and not isinstance(soft, bool) and soft > 0:
    header["input_soft"] = soft
sys.stdout.write(json.dumps([{"header": header, "messages": [c]}]))
